scripts.copy: cp README.md LICENSE build/dist && sed -e'/"private": true/d' package.json > build/dist/package.json
scripts.test-install: npm run test && (test_dir=build/install_dir; rm -rf $test_dir; mkdir -p $test_dir/node_modules; packname=`npm run xmlchars:pack --silent`; (cd $test_dir; npm install ../$packname); rm -rf $test_dir)
scripts.xmlchars:publish: npm run test-install && (cd build/dist && npm publish)
